next_question.rationale: Top gap is created→confirmed (conversion 0.3548). Play-store VOC shows an escalated payment/refund theme, and the phase1 reason clusters show large user-led cart abandonment (user abandon the cart 111993; user clicked back 83517). I expect conversion to vary by payment_method (e.g., COD, card, bank transfer, e-wallet) because payment friction/failures or perceived risk drive checkout drop-off; isolating this will show whether a few payment methods explain a large share of the 417,569 lost orders. Also request consultation_required as a second cut because an escalated consultation/doctor theme suggests orders that require a consultation (prescription-gated items) may face an extra gating step and convert worse — that could also explain much of the created→confirmed loss.
